clos.original_description: Learners should be able to explain AI-driven cybersecurity use cases, security threat detection workflows, and the machine learning development process for cybersecurity applications.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to explain AI-driven cybersecurity use cases, security threat detection workflows, and the machine learning development process for cybersecurity applications. The scope includes Introduction to AI for Cybersecurity, AI for Cybersecurity Specialization overview, AI for cybersecurity professionals, AI role in cyber threat detection, and Spam filtering and email threat detection.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to develop and evaluate machine learning models for email security, spam/phishing detection, and AI-supported authentication security.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to develop and evaluate machine learning models for email security, spam/phishing detection, and AI-supported authentication security. The scope includes Email Threat Detection, Spam and phishing email classification, Decision trees and Naïve Bayes for email security, Authentication Security with AI, Facial recognition and fake login detection, and Model evaluation for authentication tasks.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to analyze malware and network traffic features and apply supervised or unsupervised learning algorithms for malware and anomaly detection.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to analyze malware and network traffic features and apply supervised or unsupervised learning algorithms for malware and anomaly detection. The scope includes Advanced Malware and Network Anomaly Detection, Malware types and malware analysis fundamentals, Feature extraction for malware detection, Supervised learning for malware classification, Malware Threats Detection Part 2, Clustering and decision trees for malware detection, and Malware model evaluation.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to implement network anomaly detection experiments using botnet or traffic data and interpret model evaluation results for cybersecurity decision-making.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to implement network anomaly detection experiments using botnet or traffic data and interpret model evaluation results for cybersecurity decision-making. The scope includes Network Anomaly Detection with AI, Network threats and anomaly detection background, Network Traffic Analysis and Research Presentation, Anomaly detection algorithms, Model interpretation and performance analysis, and Present current trends in network anomaly detection.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to apply advanced AI security concepts, including fraud detection, GANs, adversarial machine learning, model resilience, and reinforcement learning for adaptive cybersecurity.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to apply advanced AI security concepts, including fraud detection, GANs, adversarial machine learning, model resilience, and reinforcement learning for adaptive cybersecurity. The scope includes Fraud prevention with cloud AI solutions, Credit card fraud detection, Generative AI and Adversarial Machine Learning, Fundamentals of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Synthetic data for cybersecurity, Black-box and white-box adversarial attacks, Model Resilience and Adaptive Cybersecurity, Model robustness evaluation, Reinforcement learning for adaptive cybersecurity measures, Model optimization and security strategy, AI model evaluation for cybersecurity applications, and Defensive and responsible use of AI in cybersecurity.
